items.title: The 5 Best Stocks in Berkshire Hathaway’s Portfolio
items.summary: Key TakeawaysBerkshire Hathaway’s latest 13F shows that, among its positions of 2% or more, analysts see the most upside in Alphabet, Bank of America, Occidental Petroleum and American Express. Analysts’ average targets sit 43% to 44% above Alphabet’s two share classes, 26% above Bank of America and Occidental, and 16% above American Express.
